newsitem.title: UK: BTG to market Lucent patent assets.
newsitem.headline: BTG to market Lucent patent assets.

text.p: British technology group BTG Plc said on Thursday it signed an agreement with telecommunications equipment company Lucent Technologies Inc to commercialise selected patents from Lucent.

BTG will initially look at two portfolios, one which covers superabsorbent materials -- uses for which include protecting telecommunications cables from moisture damage -- and the other high temperature superconductor technologies.
The two portfolios consist of over 100 patents worldwide.

"The collaboration with Lucent is the latest in a growing number of large corporations worldwide which are working with BTG to commercialise their intellectual property," said chief executive Ian Harvey in a statement.
BTG is a leading technology transfer company whose business is the profitable commercialisation of technology.
